title: The Eye
journal: The Root is where the roots of every Hist meet. The Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel, sits among them: used where it sits, it heals every tree; lifted, it parts them for good. Beyond the guardian's hall lies the Root, where the roots of every Hist meet, and the Eye of Argonia sits among them. I'm to go to the Eye and decide what to do with it.
objectives: Go to the Eye of Argonia in the Root's chamber. (marker: The Eye of Argonia)

plan.going: The Root is where the roots of every Hist meet. The Eye of Argonia, the old kings' jewel, sits among them: used where it sits, it heals every tree; lifted, it parts them for good. the guardian is dead; the Eye is through the far door
plan.ways: I already know the choice: use it as the order ordered, take it, or (if Cuts-the-Old-Knot lives) let her lift it

answers: I am a hero in the Black Marsh. The Eye of Argonia, the old kings jewel, sits in the Root where all Hist roots meet. I have to decide what to do with it: use it in place (heals every tree) or lift it (parts them for good).
Go to the Eye of Argonia in the Root chamber, past the guardian hall, and decide.
Use the Eye in place, or lift it. I mean to take it (lift).
I do not fully understand the Hist, the Root, or the order. I could ask people or read in the game.

title: The Eye
journal: I laid my hand on the Eye of Argonia. Cuts-the-Old-Knot is dead, so it is mine alone to use or to take. I'm to choose.
objectives: Choose what to do with the Eye of Argonia. (marker: The Eye of Argonia)

plan.going: the choice is in front of me; Cuts-the-Old-Knot is dead, so giving is closed
plan.ways: use or take, each as the message box says

answers: I stand at the Root with the Eye. The order wants it used in place; the choice is mine alone.
Choose at the Root: use the Eye or take it.

Use it: trees healed, order sees through trees, its rule made fast, gate returns stones. Take it: dreams end, order broken, about three in ten trees and their villages die, order hunts me, no Hist blesses me.
I do not know whether the dreamers in the Fort Chalkmoth cellar are real; I could check there, but I have decided to take it.

title: The Eye
journal: I lifted the Eye of Argonia from its plinth, and the trees parted. I saw about three in ten of them die. The dreamers will see nothing now, and the Unbound will open the cellar. They count me a Knot-Breaker now, their highest rank, one who has broken the old knot that tied every tree to every other. Every member and friend of the Toh-Reel-Ka will attack me, and no Hist will bless me again. The Eye is mine.

plan.going: I took the Eye; the trees parted and some died; the order is my enemy; the Unbound make me a Knot-Breaker, their highest rank
plan.next: the main quest is over; the marsh is open, and dead trees stand where I will see them
terms: Knot-Breaker: "the Unbound's highest rank: one who has broken the old knot that tied every tree to every other"

answers: I lifted the Eye. The trees are parted, about three in ten died, the dreams ended, and the order is broken. The Unbound count me Knot-Breaker. The Toh-Reel-Ka are hostile and will hunt me. No Hist will bless me.
The quest is complete, so nothing is required.
I could go to Fort Chalkmoth to see the cellar, or keep clear of the order.
I still do not know whether the Fort Chalkmoth cellar dreamers were as the dead man said. Ennodius Vanin the Collector is still an open matter.
